entries.70ded6367c2dd1ca: It has set out a long-term vision, “Grand Vision 2030,” looking ahead to fiscal 2030, and aims to become a leading environmental company that society needs. Under its medium-term management plan, it says it will supply products and propose recycling to industries expected to grow over the medium to long term, and pursue business growth and earnings expansion. To meet growing demand for recycling of used chemicals in electronics fields such as semiconductors, batteries and electronic components, it aims to start operations at a subsidiary's recycling plant in Kitakyushu City from fiscal 2027, and says it will also address domestic circulation of resources such as precious metals and rare metals.
